import itertools

def solve_for_n(n):
    elements = list(range(n))
    perms = list(itertools.permutations(elements))
    total_sum = 0
    for p in perms:
        # Fixed points
        v = sum(1 for i in range(n) if p[i] == i)
        # Sign of permutation
        # Use the fact that sign is (-1)^(n - number of cycles)
        visited = [False] * n
        num_cycles = 0
        for i in range(n):
            if not visited[i]:
                num_cycles += 1
                curr = i
                while not visited[curr]:
                    visited[curr] = True
                    curr = p[curr]
        sigma = (-1)**(n - num_cycles)
        total_sum += sigma / (v + 1)
    return total_sum

for n in range(1, 7):
    print(f"n={n}, W={solve_for_n(n)}")
